funder_origin_name: Lundbeck Foundation (Lundbeckfonden), via the Grete Lundbeck European Brain Research Foundation
funding_share_basis: The Lundbeck Foundation has supplied 100% of the purse since the prize was established in 2010 (first awarded 2011); no co-funder was found. At founding the money was channelled through a dedicated vehicle, the charitable Grete Lundbeck European Brain Research Foundation, which conferred the prize through roughly 2016 and was itself created and endowed by the Lundbeck Foundation; from about 2017-2018 onward award announcements name the Lundbeck Foundation directly. That is a change of payment vehicle within the same funder, not a handover, so funder_changed is false.
money_note: Current purse is DKK 10 million (approx. EUR 1.3 million) paid annually by the Lundbeck Foundation; the prize was EUR 1 million from 2011 through at least 2018 before being restated in kroner at the higher level.
status_note: Renamed: launched as The Grete Lundbeck European Brain Research Prize (awarded 2011 onward) and marketed as The Brain Prize from the start; the Grete Lundbeck name was dropped from official materials by the late 2010s. Also broadened from a European to a global prize. Awarded continuously every year since 2011, so the winner list is unbroken under the name we use.
evidence_quote: The one million euro Brain Prize is awarded by the independent, charitable Grethe Lundbeck European Brain Research Foundation, The Brain Prize. (2015 press release); The Brain Prize was founded in 2011 by the Lundbeck Foundation. (brainprize.org)
judgment_reason: The Lundbeck Foundation is a Danish enterprise foundation and controlling shareholder of H. Lundbeck A/S (also ALK-Abello and Falck), so a reasonable coder could call it Corporate; the protocol codes enterprise foundations as Philanthropy. A coder could also record the Grete Lundbeck European Brain Research Foundation as a distinct origin funder and set funder_changed true; we treat it as a Lundbeck-endowed vehicle for the same money, so the funder never changed.
